name: STICKEE | Cali Octane | Indica | Live Resin Concentrate | 1G
description: CALI OCTANE is the strain that says, “Why not taste like citrus AND jet fuel?” Because nothing screams “good time” like a grapefruit doing donuts in a diesel parking lot. This 70% indica live resin isn’t here to play nice. First, it floods your brain with ideas you’ll absolutely never finish. Then it pulls the plug and rocks you to sleep like a lullaby wrapped in a burrito blanket. Born from Dream Queen, I-369, and Papaya, Cali Octane is basically science’s way of saying, “Let’s get weird… and then let’s nap.” So spark it up, lean back, and let your night go from brainstorm to snore storm in record time.
